description: Physics-lumped single-effect MVC evaporator. Brine boils at T_brine; a mechanical compressor lifts the generated vapor to a higher saturation temperature (T_steam) so the same vapor is reused as heating steam (heat-pump-like, electricity-driven, no external steam). Lumped evaporator energy/level transient via scipy.solve_ivp. SEC ~7-12 kWh/m3.

unit.name: Generic seawater MVC evaporator (forced-circulation)
unit.source: El-Dessouky & Ettouney (2002) Fundamentals of Salt Water Desalination, Ch.6; Veza (1995) Mechanical vapour compression desalination plants, Desalination 101:1-10

capacity_m3_day.note: Design distillate production (small/medium MVC unit, Veza 1995)

T_brine_C.note: Evaporator boiling temperature; MVC runs 55-70 C (El-Dessouky & Ettouney 2002, Ch.6)

delta_T_lift_C.note: Net useful temperature driving force across evaporator tubes after BPE; compressor lift is delta_T_lift + BPE (El-Dessouky 2002 typical 3-5 C)

compressor_efficiency.note: Isentropic+mechanical efficiency of centrifugal vapor compressor (Veza 1995)

UA_kW_K.note: Overall evaporator conductance U*A (lumped); sized so UA*(dT_lift-BPE) matches design latent demand at steady state. Implies U~2.5 kW/m2K, A~440 m2 (El-Dessouky 2002 evaporator U for falling-film)

evap_holdup_kg.note: Brine liquid holdup in evaporator sump (lumped thermal mass)

evap_metal_mass_kg.note: Tube/shell metal mass lumped with liquid for thermal inertia

level_area_m2.note: Evaporator sump cross-sectional area for level dynamics

T_feed_C.note: Raw seawater feed temperature (preheated to near-brine in practice via regenerator; raw value used for sensible-heat demand)

feed_preheat_eff.note: Regenerative feed-preheater effectiveness; feed brought to within ~1 K pinch of brine using hot distillate + brine streams (El-Dessouky 2002)

cp_brine_kJ_kgK.note: Seawater specific heat ~42 g/kg, 60 C (Sharqawy, Lienhard & Zubair 2010, Desal. Water Treat. 16:354-380)

rho_brine_kg_m3.note: Seawater density at 60 C, 42 g/kg (Sharqawy et al. 2010)

hfg_ref_kJ_kg.note: Latent heat of vaporization of water at 60 C (NIST/IAPWS-IF97)

cp_vapor_kJ_kgK.note: Superheated steam cp near 60 C, low pressure (NIST)

gamma_vapor.note: Ratio of specific heats of low-pressure steam

R_vapor_kJ_kgK.note: Specific gas constant of water vapor

BPE_const.note: Boiling point elevation from Sharqawy et al. (2010) correlation, computed in model from salinity and T
